dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Hello! Please take a seat wherever you like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What drinks do you have?

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Here's our menu. Have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, pretty good. We do get the occasional minor incident, but it's better for things to be lively around here, rather than stale. Right?

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Besides, even handling trouble can be fun all on its own.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any interesting news lately?

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Hmm... Ever since the Fatui set up their experimental design bureau on Paha Isle, the atmosphere around the place has changed a lot. Some say it's because they're battling the Wild Hunt, but who knows for certain?

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Some dislike the way they throw their weight around, but others are eager to get their mitts on their new technology.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: But the Frostmoon Scions' view of them has remained constant... Thinking back on what the Fatui have done to those statues, it's not hard to see why. If you ask me, they'll come to blows sooner rather than later.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any interesting news lately?

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Well, I'd be remiss if I didn't mention that blow the experimental design bureau took. However you slice it, the Fatui have taken a hit — and aside from the Frostmoon Scions, plenty of other folks were plenty pleased about that setback.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: But... We probably shouldn't be talking about this in the open. We still have to do business with them, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just taking a little stroll.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: No worries. You're always welcome here.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Welcome, Mr. Flins. The wine you ordered previously has arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Why thank you, Mr. Demyan. Where would I find fine spirits here if not for your aid, I wonder...

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Ah, you're too modest, sir. Between us, I'd say you're the one with the more refined taste.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: The varieties you recommended before have been massive hits with our clientele. Why, our stock sold out before you could say "cider." Made a tidy profit off that, to boot.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ah, I was simply giving you a few suggestions. If anything, I would credit this to your professional ethic as an alcohol tradesman.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: "No water mixed in, no low-quality drinks," you mean? Well, that has made me a fair shade less Mora, but it's also the reason we can continue operating.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Alright, sir, come with me. I've specially placed your wine in our cellar. You have our guarantee that it hasn't lost an iota of its flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I look forward to its. Oh, and could you bring two glasses? I believe we should partake of a sip or two first.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Of course, sir. Two glasses, one bottle, a beautiful moment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to be in a good mood.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Haha, thanks! I'm sure that's why my boss sent me here. A duty to fit the man, is what they say.
